transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for offering to help with the plant care. Let me start by laying out what we're working with. We have three plants to care for from July 1 through July 14: a jade plant, an orchid, and a Boston fern. The jade plant needs strong direct light, the orchid needs bright indirect light and humidity, and the Boston fern does best in shade and steady moisture. I have a sunny south-facing sunroom at my place, and both Marco and Talia have offered to keep plants at their homes. I also want to flag that the owner's care card specifies the orchid should be watered on July 2, July 6, July 10, and July 14. Before I make any final decisions on placement, I'd love to hear from Marco and Talia about what conditions you can offer at your homes — lighting, humidity, that sort of thing. That way we can match each plant to the best environment.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Hi Lena and Talia! I can take the orchid at my place — I have a humid bathroom with bright indirect light, which should be a great fit for it. There's one thing I need to flag though: I'll be away from July 6 through July 8, so I won't be able to handle the July 6 watering that's on the care card. Lena, would you be able to cover that one watering for the orchid on July 6? If so, I can handle the July 2, July 10, and July 14 waterings myself. Let me know, and then we can figure out the jade plant and Boston fern from there.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I should let you both know — my cat chews on jade leaves, so the jade plant can't safely stay at my place. However, my shaded porch would be a great fit for the Boston fern, since it needs shade and steady moisture.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Lena will cover the July 6 orchid watering while Marco is away July 6-8.
Lena will keep the jade plant in her sunny south-facing sunroom, which provides the strong direct light it needs.
Talia will keep the Boston fern on her shaded porch, which provides the shade and steady moisture it needs.
Marco will keep the orchid in his humid bathroom with bright indirect light.
